tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window and screen ground (semantic appBackground): the library grid, settings, journal, the rail, and the top bar's glass tint. Text on it is on-background or on-surface-variant.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn straight on background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Side sheets (semantic surfaceBase). The top bar and rail sit on background, not on this.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, panel, sheet and dialog.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Dark themes' reader canvas behind comic pages (readerCanvas). Not used for app chrome.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Track of the segmented row (AppSegmentedRow).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Panels: settings groups, journal panels, the reading card's fallback (semantic surfaceRaised).

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and the search field's pill (semantic surfaceOverlay).

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, progress tracks, and a search field placed on a dialog.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting lines, counts, captions, sheet section labels.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: outlined buttons, the open state of a panel's edge.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairlines: chip edges, row dividers (drawn at 60% in AppSettingsRowDivider).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The accent: filled buttons, switches, progress fill. One filled button per surface.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Selected things (semantic surfaceSelected): the selected settings row, the rail's indicator, a selected segment and a selected chip.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container (semantic onSurfaceSelected).

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Kept for Material defaults; the kit selects with primary-container instead.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: The journal's second series (comics beside books) and its finished markers.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive text and icons: Remove from library, errors in forms.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill (the destructive filled button).

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The snackbar (Updated to x.y.z).

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and side sheets: 45% in dark themes, 32% in light; light themes' reader canvas.

tokens.name: app-background
tokens.usage: Semantic alias the kit uses for the window.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: panels and settings groups.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: menus, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: the selected row or rail item.

tokens.name: on-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: text on a selected row.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: AppScreenTitle: a title that IS the content (a series, a Kavita list, a first-launch question). 32/36 on phones. Never a screen's own name.

styles.name: period-title
styles.usage: The journal's period between its arrows. 26 on phones.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: A heading on the page ground above a grid or list, flush with the gutter (the library's All books). 18/24 on phones. A count beside it uses count.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: AppPanelHeader: the title of a side sheet, bottom sheet or reader panel. Every sheet uses it; no sheet draws its own.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: The label above a group of rows or tiles on a page (AppSettingsGroup), flush with the panel edge.

styles.name: sheet-label
styles.usage: A section label inside a sheet or dialog (filters, book page, What's new), in on-surface-variant.

styles.name: menu-heading
styles.usage: AppMenuHeading inside a dropdown menu, in on-surface-variant.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: A label over a cover-tinted title: the reading card's
. Sentence case, no tracking, in the cover's accent. No capitals and no wide tracking: a label is told apart by colour and weight.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Material titleMedium: the title of a row (AppSettingsRow), a book row's title at 15.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Use neutral dark surfaces with stronger layer contrast.
styles.usage: Material bodyLarge: paragraphs and field text.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Material bodyMedium: supporting lines under a row title, in on-surface-variant.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Material labelLarge: buttons; chips set it SemiBold.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: A count after a chip or tab label, at 70% of the label colour; beside a section heading 14-15 in on-surface-variant. Regular and in tabular figures, like every count, percentage, time and stat.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Material labelMedium: a panel header's subtitle, tile meta.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Material labelSmall: the smallest text, on tiles.

spacing.note: dp in the app, px here (1 dp = 1 px in the previews). Window classes: Compact under 600 dp, Medium 600 to 839, Expanded from 840 (AppWindowSize).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen margin from 600 dp (Medium and Expanded): the distance from the window or the rail's hairline to content, on every screen. The top bar's glass edge sits on it too.

tokens.name: gutter-compact
tokens.usage: Screen margin under 600 dp (phones).

tokens.name: bar-top
tokens.usage: Status bar to the top bar's glass.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The top bar (AppTopBar).

tokens.name: bar-bottom
tokens.usage: Below the bar; with bar-top and bar-height makes the 76 content inset.

tokens.name: content-top
tokens.usage: First content below the 76 inset, on every screen (84 from the status bar). Both panes of a two-pane screen start here.

tokens.name: content-bottom
tokens.usage: Space after the last content of a scrolling screen, above the navigation bar inset.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page: reading card to shelves, one settings group to the next, journal panels.

tokens.name: heading-gap
tokens.usage: A heading or group label to the thing it heads.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Between cover tiles, across and down, and between side-by-side panels.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Inside every panel, card, sheet and row: AppSettingsRow, AppPanelHeader, AppFormRow, the reading card, journal panels, side-sheet bodies.

tokens.name: inset-dialog
tokens.usage: Inside a dialog card (AppDialogCard, AppListDialog) and an empty state.

tokens.name: inset-menu
tokens.usage: Inside a dropdown menu: items, headings and any control in it.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a settings row; 52 for a value row inside a sheet.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size in rows, bars and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-gap
tokens.usage: Leading icon to text in a row; dividers start at inset + icon + icon-gap (60).

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Every side sheet (book page, filters, downloads, journal day). Under 600 dp it becomes a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-margin
tokens.usage: Window edge to a side sheet or floating panel.

tokens.name: list-pane-width
tokens.usage: The list pane of a two-pane screen (the settings hub beside its open page).

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a dialog card.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: Book covers and cover thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Text fields, the search field, the segmented row's track, menus, list rows that highlight, theme tiles' inner preview. Fields and tracks hold things; they are not pills.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: A part inside a radius-control container with 4 around it: the segments of a segmented row (12 less the padding).

tokens.name: radius-container
tokens.usage: Panels, settings groups, the reading card, the top bar, journal panels.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, side sheets and reader bars.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Things you tap to act or pick: buttons, chips, tab pills. Not fields, tracks or status.
